name: Reach Ten Holdings Berhad
overview: Reach Ten Holdings Berhad 于2026年通过其全资子公司 Reach Ten Communication Sdn Bhd 投资 Alta Fund 的 AAF4 基金，间接获得 SpaceX 的敞口，初始投资额为 USD1,000,080（约 RM4.2 million）。此外，公司宣派截至2026财政年度每股1 sen的中期股息。
overview_en: Reach Ten Holdings Berhad, through its wholly-owned subsidiary Reach Ten Communication Sdn Bhd, invested in Alta Fund's AAF4 fund in 2026, gaining indirect exposure to SpaceX with an initial investment of USD1,000,080 (approximately RM4.2 million). The company also declared an interim single-tier dividend of one sen per ordinary share for the financial year ending 31 December 2026.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note_en: At the company level, it made a fund investment for indirect SpaceX exposure and declared an interim dividend.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 通过全资子公司 Reach Ten Communication Sdn Bhd 投资 Alta Fund 的 AAF4 基金，初始投资额 USD1,000,080（约 RM4.2 million），间接获得 SpaceX 敞口。
actions.text_en: Invested in Alta Fund's AAF4 fund through wholly-owned subsidiary Reach Ten Communication Sdn Bhd, with an initial investment of USD1,000,080 (approximately RM4.2 million), gaining indirect exposure to SpaceX.
